assertion: Elon Musk said Wednesday he feels “pretty foolish” about pouring nearly half a billion dollars into Republican campaigns during the 2026 midterms.
inaccuracy: The claim says 'nearly half a billion dollars'; the evidence says at least $445 million (AP, and the article's own figure) and about $358M in filings through Sept 30.
measure: Elon Musk FEC contributions 2026 super PAC
sql: SELECT committee_id, SUM(amount) FROM fec.individual_contributions WHERE year=2026 AND contributor_name ILIKE 'MUSK, ELON%' AND amount>=100000 GROUP BY committee_id
independent_value: Al Jazeera (Nov 19) and Daily Wire confirm quote and date; AP $445M

assertion: The admission comes after Musk spent at least $445 million supporting Republicans in federal races, according to campaign finance watchdog OpenSecrets.
inaccuracy: The claim attributes the figure to OpenSecrets; the evidence found attributes $445M to AP, and OpenSecrets was not confirmed. Warehouse filings through Sept 30 show about $358M.
sql: SELECT SUM(amount) FROM fec.individual_contributions WHERE year=2026 AND contributor_name ILIKE 'MUSK, ELON%' AND amount>=100000

assertion: Musk donated $158 million to a Republican Senate super PAC, which transferred matching sums to a group supporting Ken Paxton.
inaccuracy: The claim says $158M; the warehouse shows $168M to SLF PAC by Sept 23 (four gifts). The claim says the PAC transferred matching sums; the earlier TheWrap piece says it is unclear the money was Musk's directly.
sql: SELECT SUM(amount) FROM fec.individual_contributions WHERE year=2026 AND contributor_name ILIKE 'MUSK, ELON%' AND committee_id IN (SELECT committee_id FROM fec.committees WHERE committee_name='SLF PAC' AND year=2026)
